description: Sensitivity analyses: alternative heat definitions, pollutant and covariate adjustment, pandemic-year exclusion, and the superseded analysis sample.

sources.kind: aggregate model output as a formatted text table, parsed by scripts/build_aggregates.py

notes: Sensitivity rows do not carry FDR q values except where the source file provides them; they were not part of the 156-test confirmatory family.
Some pandemic-exclusion cells failed to fit (singular matrix) upstream and are absent rather than imputed.
Rows for Wenzhou and Xiamen appear in some sensitivity families because the upstream file includes them; they are supplementary cohorts.

models.m2: Cluster-robust OLS additionally adjusted for air-quality covariates, fitted on the air-quality available subset.
models.m3: Cluster-robust OLS with relative humidity added, and a heat-index variant.
models.m4: Cluster-robust OLS with body-mass index and education added.
models.m5: Cluster-robust OLS, donor-level clustering, outcome standardised within cohort.
models.m6: Cluster-robust OLS on the earlier, non-canonical harmonised table; retained to show how much the result depends on the analysis sample definition.
